scope: Full Chinese and English versions read for all three essays.
Five complete paragraph-aligned translations, including fictional numbers, opposing arguments, qualifications and all original reference URLs.

Ep01: noncompetition normative position, costly objection, genuinely additional payment and actual affordability, ownership independent of clause labels, legal capacity versus mental capacity, explicit disagreement with UN committee.
Ep02: wealth ceiling versus use limits, Robeyns not caricatured, wealth versus actual conduct, material dependence versus proof of a completed exchange, preventive reach versus verdict.

Ep03: four platform constraints, separation as last resort not never, basic support not repayment, feasibility not permission to cross limits, care and disability, institutional rather than applicant-only correction.

english_review.change: ep03 paragraphs 1, 5, 12 and 22: stop selling here does not assert an alternative sales destination; decisions must remain challengeable rather than describing closure of every route; entrepreneurial support does not specify a loan; basic support is not grounded in a duty to repay society. Other English prose retained.

limitations: Independent AI semantic comparison completed for all five new languages; no claim of native-speaker external review.
Paragraph alignment and structural tests establish completeness of units, not by themselves semantic quality.
